text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-4523 triggered for service=redwood-inference-prod (us-east-1). Reason: sustained 5xx spike from inference-runtime (p95 1200ms, 5xx rate 18%). Paging primary on-call. https://pagerduty.example/PD-4523 :rotating_light:
alice.oncall: ACK PD-4523. I'm on it. grabbing logs and checking model-server health. :wave:
alice.oncall: quick check: `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep model-server` shows 3/5 pods in CrashLoopBackOff on node gpu-07
bob.secondary: got a duplicate page for PD-4523 too — looked like two PD alerts fired within 30s. did primary ack succeed?
alice.oncall: I acked via the PD app at 2023-08-14T02:10Z — PD shows me as acknowledged but then we got an escalation to manager? odd.
pd-bot: PagerDuty escalation: PD-4523 escalated to Carol (manager) because secondary ack limit not met (escalation policy: 2 mins -> secondary, 10 mins -> manager). See incident timeline: https://pagerduty.example/PD-4523/timeline
carol.manager: I got woken up by PD. I'm awake, acknowledging now. ACK. Please post a concise summary and mitigation steps.
dave-runtime: logs show `OOMKilled` on model-server container around 02:07Z and then rapid restarts. probable memory leak in v2.1.3 artifact. Filtered error: `2023-08-14T02:07:23Z ERROR out-of-memory allocating kv-cache`
erin-support: customer impact: we have two active clients reporting generation timeouts from us-east with user-facing errors. Ticket #INC-998 attached. We'll notify affected customers as degraded.
alice.oncall: mitigation plan: 1) cordon node gpu-07, 2) scale up model-server to spin new pods on other nodes, 3) route traffic to model-quantized-variant temporarily. executing step 1 now.
alice.oncall: `kubectl cordon gpu-07 && kubectl drain gpu-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -n inference`
dave-runtime: also toggling autoscaler to prevent restarting the leak causing flapping: `kubectl apply -f /deploy/autoscaler-restrict.yaml` (scaling cap 3->5 paused).
bob.secondary: FYI I'm onsite-available; if you want me to take over the PD incident as primary, I can. currently on a call but can jump in.
alice.oncall: thanks @bob.secondary — handing off after I confirm replication. I'll post a short status before stepping out in 18m.
pd-bot: PagerDuty notice: duplicate alerts detected for PD-4523; root cause likely duplicate webhook from monitoring (monitoring -> alertmanager -> PD) — temporarily silencing identical matches for 5m to avoid alert storm.
alice.oncall: good call. silenced noise. back to mitigation — scaled up replicas, killing CrashLooping pods. Monitoring: `promql: sum(rate(inference_5xx_total[1m])) by (instance)` shows decline from 18% -> 6% in last 3m.
erin-support: updating affected customers: "We're investigating increased error rates in US-East; mitigation in progress; ETA 30m" — posting to status page.
dave-runtime: I pushed a temporary config that pins runtime to model-quantized-variant for the hot route: `SERVICE_ROUTING=quantized-v1` -- this bypasses the buggy v2.1.3 until we have a patch.
carol.manager: thanks. can we suppress manager escalation for the next 30m while mitigation completes? want to avoid repeated wakeups if PD duplicate pages continue.
alice.oncall: requesting suppression now. `pd silence add PD-4523 --duration 30m --reason "mitigation in progress"`
pd-bot: PD silence created: PD-4523 silenced for 30m by alice.oncall. Manager escalations will be suppressed during this period.
bob.secondary: model traffic is routing properly to quantized variant, 5xx rate down to 1.8% p95 latency 320ms. good to hand off?
alice.oncall: handing off to @bob.secondary — I'm going offline for 20m (lunch). Current status: degraded -> restoring. customer-facing page updated. No ongoing restarts after drain. Follow-on: postmortem and action item to fix v2.1.3 memory leak.
bob.secondary: taking the incident. ACK handoff. I'll monitor for 60m and then close if stable.
carol.manager: noted. thanks everyone — good coordination. file an RCA ticket and flag runtime team. I'll avoid additional PD escalations while this is monitored.
incident-bot: Incident PD-4523 update: acknowledged by alice.oncall and later carol.manager; silenced for 30m; mitigations applied (node drain, routing to quantized variant). Current impact: partial degradation resolved. Postmortem assigned to dave-runtime.
erin-support: creating support postmortem thread and linking customer tickets.
alice.oncall: leaving thread. ping @bob.secondary if anything spikes. :wave:
